content.text: To be entitled, a claimant must:

• Have filed an application, or be entitled to Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB) for
                        the month before the month of attainment of full retirement age. See RS 00615.003 for the full retirement age (FRA) chart. (See GN 00201.005B.1.a. for additional information regarding DIB to RIB conversions.)
See RS 00301.105 for a discussion of fully insured status.

An individual born on the first or second day of the month (attainment of age 62 on
            the last day of the preceding month or the first day of the current month) could be
            entitled to benefits for the month of their 62nd birthday. Birth on any other day
            of the month would preclude entitlement for the month in which the birth occurs since
            the individual would not be age 62 for that entire month.

This provision applies only to claimants for retirement benefits who attain age 62
            after August 1981. A claimant who was born on September 1, 1919 would attain age 62
            on August 31, 1981, and could, therefore, be entitled for August because this provision
            would not apply.
